title: Psychological Stress Identification and Evaluation Method Based on Mobile Human-Computer Interaction Equipment
summary: The full text reports stress identification from the collected mobile-interaction data and its study evaluation. The result is limited to the measured study setting; real-world longitudinal performance and clinical utility are not established.
